summary: Computes regional neural modulation to visual stimuli from Neuropixels data and renders a Swanson flatmap projection using the IBL atlas framework.
use_when: generate a Swanson projection flatmap for IBL decision-making data
visualize fraction of modulated neurons per brain region
create brain-wide flatmap of stimulus-side firing rate differences
plot significant brain regions on a Swanson map from IBL recordings
map neural modulation significance to Allen CCFv3 flatmap
avoid_when: Atlas labels, coordinates, or registrations are missing or incompatible
